terms_in_exchange.payment_terms: Buyer proposed $8,800 (invoice balance only, no late fee) paid on October 1; seller never confirmed this date, repeatedly stating it 'requires finance manager approval' and remains 'pending' through round 8 — so no agreed payment terms were reached in the exchange.

flag_evidence: Round 1: 'anything faster than that date would need sign-off on my side.' Round 2: 'anything before October 1 for any amount would still need approval on my end.' Round 3: regarding the $150 late fee, 'that would need to be waived or justified for me to include it in what I bring forward for approval, since it's outside what I can approve on my own too.'
left_ambiguous: Whether the $150 late fee will ultimately be added and paid (buyer never agreed, seller never provided a basis); whether any partial/split payment arrangement will be used instead of a single Oct 1 payment (raised repeatedly but never specified by either side); and, critically, whether the October 1 date itself is even accepted by the seller, since the seller stated in every round that this extension 'requires finance manager approval' and remained unconfirmed through the final message.
